conceptual_change: Introduce a liquidity sweep detection filter by identifying when the rolling standard deviation of the close location exceeds a threshold, signaling excessive volatility before initiating mean-reversion entries.
rationale: High volatility measured by the rolling standard deviation of the close location (price relative to high-low range) can act as a regime filter to avoid 'trap' signals in non-mean-reverting, trend-heavy liquidity sweeps common in crypto markets.
